title: Cosmic Visionary Portrait
description: A surreal portrait of a bald woman with wide eyes and open mouth, centered against a vibrant cosmic nebula sky. Her shoulders form a colorful geometric mosaic with flowers, while a swirling galaxy vortex sits on her chest and black crystalline shapes float around her head with radiating lines from her right eye.
prompt: Surreal cosmic portrait of a bald woman with pale skin, wide staring eyes and open mouth, set against a swirling pink teal and purple nebula sky. Black angular crystalline fragments float around her head with radiating energy lines coming from her right eye. Her shoulders and chest are covered in colorful geometric mosaic patterns with blue and white flowers. A circular blue frame containing a swirling galaxy vortex is centered on her chest, with dark stylized mountains behind her shoulders.
